summary: Implemented a deterministic offline/paper order plan generator for crypto numeric review outputs. It creates one paper_limit_order entry for the paper_candidate row, emits no-action entries for watchlist/reject rows, applies fixture risk limits, and preserves locked safety flags.
limitations: Consumes offline review-table output only; it does not fetch live markets or prices.
Produces paper review artifacts only; it does not create real orders, wallet actions, or runtime actions.
Risk limits are deterministic fixture constants scoped to this local paper implementation.
recommended_next_task: PMBOT-BRAIN-004-CRYPTO-NUMERIC-PAPER-PLAN-AUDIT: add a deterministic paper-plan audit that validates generated plan entries against risk limits and safety flags.
